overview.en:
Skill for pulling SEO tags from any URL — title, meta description, OG tags, canonical, H1s, robots — so the model can audit how a page presents itself to search engines and social scrapers.

Inspect public page metadata without claiming access to search-console or ranking data. Keep the inspected URL and extracted values in the report.

Use this plugin in a Ghast conversation with the relevant inputs or project context. The bundled workflow guides the task; any required external tools or runtime must be available in your environment.
overview.zh-CN:
提取网页标题、描述、分享标签、规范链接与搜索引擎相关元数据。

检查公开页面元数据，不声称能访问搜索控制台或排名数据；报告中保留检查网址与提取值。

在 Ghast 对话中提供相关输入或项目背景后使用本插件。随附流程会指导任务；所需外部工具或运行环境仍需在本机可用。

starterPrompts.en: Check this page's title, description, and canonical URL.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 检查这个页面的标题、描述与规范网址。

starterPrompts.en: Compare the social-sharing metadata of these two pages.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 比较这两个页面的社交分享元数据。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare a metadata audit for this landing page.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 为这个落地页准备元数据审查。

descriptions.en: Use this skill when the user asks to audit, review, or extract SEO meta tags from a webpage — `<title>`, meta description, canonical, robots, OpenGraph, Twitter Card, H1s. Fetches the raw HTML and pulls out the head-section signals search engines and social scrapers consume.
